phc_dti

Source: R/data.R
phc_dti.Rd

NACCADRC ADSP PHC Imaging DTI dataset. All NACC DTI data processed through PHC (Contains legacy/mixed protocol data, as well as SCAN-compliant data on ADRC participants funded through any mechanism, including P30 funds, CLARiTI funded, or other sources). The data is sourced from the file(s) NACC_ADSP_PHC_DTI_2026.02.18.csv.

Usage

data(phc_dti)

Format

A data frame with 1002 rows and 12309 variables:

NACCID

Subject ID ( Prefix ""NACC"" followed by six numbers)

SUBJID

ADSP Subject ID

Session

Image visit or date information

NACCVNUM

Visit Number

PHC_Visit

Harmonized Visit Number

PHC_Age_DTI

Age at each DTI visit

Imaging_Site

Site of Imaging

Imaging_Date

Date of Imaging

Manufacturer

MRI Manufacturer

Model

MRI Manufacturer Model Name

FieldStrength

Magnetic Field Strength

RepetitionTime

Repetition Time

EchoTime

Echo Time

FlipAngle

Flip Angle

PixelSpacing_X

Resolution in the x direction

PixelSpacing_Y

Resolution in the y direction

SliceThickness

Resolution in the z direction

NumberOfDiffusionDirections

Number of Diffusion Directions

PHC_jhu_superior_parietal_wm_left_fa_median

The median of fractional anisotropy (FA) in the SUPERIOR_PARIETAL__WM_left region from the Atlas JHU MNI SS WMPM Type-III atlas. (PHC Harmonized)

betweenness_centrality

Average betweenness centrality computed over all nodes in SLANT atlas. Betweenness centrality is the sum of ratio between shortest paths that contain node and the total number of shortest paths (Raw)

modularity

Modularity is the quality of division of the network into modules (Raw)

assortativity

Assortativity is the correlation coefficient between the degrees of all nodes on two opposite ends of a connection and reflects network resiliancy (Raw)

participation

The average participation coefficient computed over all nodes in the SLANT atlas. Participation coefficient characterizes the diversity of intermodular connections of nodes (Raw)

clustering

The average clustering coefficient, computed over all nodes in the SLANT atlas. Clustering coefficient is the possibility that any two neighbors of a node are also connected (Raw)

nodal_strength

Average node strength is computed over all nodes in the SLANT atlas. Node strength is the number of streamlines connecting a node (Raw)

local_efficiency

Average local efficiency is computed over all nodes in the SLANT atlas. Local efficiency is the ability of information to move around nodal subsets (Raw)

global_efficiency

Global efficiency is the ability for information to move around the whole network (Raw)

density

Density is the number of present connections to the total number of connections possible (Raw)

rich_club

Rich club networks have subgroups of central nodes that tend to interact with one another (Raw)

path_length

The characteristic path length is the average shortest path, in millimeters, to traverse the network (Raw)

edge_count

The number of edges in the average shortest path to traverse the network (Raw)

https://www.naccdata.org/about-nacc-data/.
